pages.text: $(l)Top-tier sword builds$() combine specific enchantments via correct applicators: Sharpness (Superenchant Arcana), Sweeping Edge (Aether Superenchant), Looting (Slime Sword), Unbreaking (Shickaxe), and remaining enchants via

AbyssalCraft’s Enchantment Applicator—$(l)not$() IF Applicator. The Stasis Blade (especially Max Quickdraw upgrade) and Ice Dragonsteel offer highest raw damage; Kikoku enables spam-clicking. $(l)Avoid Multishot on modded bows$() (e.g., Draconic Bow)—it only works on vanilla and CoFH bows.

$(l)Armor & protection$(): Bedrock armor is best overworld set; for magic damage (common in Nether), add Thaumcraft Magic Protection (duplicable to max level via Bibliocraft). Elite Realmite offers high raw armor.
Tinkers’ armor uses Knightslime plates (3 HP/piece), Chocolate trim (Uplifting), and Unbreakable modifier as priority.
